summary: GoPro entered into a merger agreement with Action Acquisitions and its subsidiary Starman Optical, taking the company private. Each GoPro share will convert into 0.1 share of the surviving corporation's common stock plus $1.14 in cash, subject to working capital adjustment. The board unanimously approved and recommends the deal to stockholders. Merger Sub will merge into GoPro, which survives. Watch for stockholder vote, regulatory approvals, and appraisal rights; the mix of cash and stock implies a leveraged buyout structure with ongoing equity participation.
